description: Train a fresh multiscale temporal-attention network to restore IQ directly, with receiver/scenario balanced source training and frozen F.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU3, source-only training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256] direct multiscale waveform network; no DURA or physical mixture
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test
data.validation_ref: Source validation RX4/6 and source heldout RX8 excluded from fit; evaluation planned separately
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Previously explored source records and views; source training is not independent test.

checkpoint.initialization: New attention restorer initialized as identity; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA or physical model.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; fixed source roles and IDs; no restoration checkpoint.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 8192 randomly selected source fit IDs disjoint from validation, holdout and prior sample; source epochs 21/22/23, 8 training epochs; final checkpoint; no automatic target test.

execution.launch_owner: Codex source direct mixture pilot owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU3 single owner, TF32 disabled; real mixed L_s/U_s source gradient preflight

dimensions: source training only; no validation scores
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Receiver/scenario balanced waveform MSE + frozen F CE + normalized feature match + clean identity loss. Only L_s fit truth and high-confidence U_s pseudo labels; no U_s truth, V or test.

rows.purpose: explore waveform restoration independently of DURA and physical mixture
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 8192 fit IDs, 3 source views, 8 epochs; fixed final checkpoint
